# Remove underscores, dashes, extra spaces, and special characters except for hyphens and apostrophes
def standardize_name(value):
    value = re.sub(r'[_-]', ' ', value)  # remove underscores and dashes

    value = re.sub(r'[^\w\s']', '', value)  # remove special characters except for hyphens and apostrophes
